code.basis: Lines: executable statements (no branch measurement) in the system's own source, the 7 files of the interceptor package (interceptor/__init__.py, interceptor/errors.py, interceptor/formats.py, interceptor/github_source.py, interceptor/jenkins_source.py, interceptor/service.py, interceptor/source.py); the coverage instrumentation itself, third-party libraries, the tester and tests are excluded. Measured in-process with coverage.py 7.17.0 (sysmon core, all threads) from POST /test/setup until the first GET /test/report for this session, or until the next session's setup if that comes first. Statements that run only at import time (imports, def and class lines) execute before any session and so count as not covered. The measurement is process-wide, so other traffic during the session is included.

component.basis: Components listed in the pod specification (oracle.json 'components'); a component counts as covered when at least one executed test exercises it

system.basis: Acceptance criteria AC-01..AC-08 from the pod specification (Phase 2 section 4.1); a criterion counts as covered when its test was executed (pass or fail)
